Build custom real estate tools for offers and deal tracking
A rental owner used Codex to build tools for formulating offer prices, building property analysis reports with field photos, and tracking transactions under contract.
Done with
CX
Codex
What they did
A real estate entrepreneur said they used Codex to build custom internal tools their team uses every day rather than off-the-shelf software. The tools they named were a program for formulating offer prices while on the phone, a property analysis report builder that used photos from the field, and a custom transaction-management tool for tracking deals already under contract; the post does not spell out the build steps or any manual review process.
How it went
The reported result was operational use inside the business: these tools were in daily use by the team. The post gives no performance metrics, savings, or failure cases, so the outcome is described only at a high level.
Try it yourself
with
Codex
Copy prompt
In this folder, build a simple tool for my rental investing that takes a property's [address, list price, rent estimate, repair costs] and calculates a suggested maximum offer price using [my formula or target return]. It should also generate a property analysis report that includes photos from [folder of field photos], and keep a tracker of properties under contract with key dates. It is done when I can run it on one sample property and open the report, and please explain how to run it.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/AiForSmallBusiness/comments/1rcjx6n/ive_been_using_ai_in_my_real_estate_business
